description: core/data sync vectors for protocol version 1 (spec/data-domain.cddl). The top-level vectors are the have, request and entries frames the scenarios use, round-tripped like any other file. The `data_sync` section holds scenarios over a key-value store: each starts from a store (key and value in hex) and runs steps (head_seq_for, append_own_entry, handle_data_have, handle_data_request, handle_data_entries, read_entries), each recording what it returns and the whole store after it. The log layout is part of the contract: data/<device-id-hex>/head holds the head as decimal text and data/<device-id-hex>/entry/<seq> one entry, so a store written by one implementation is read by the other. The outcomes are written by hand from the spec, never produced by an implementation. Device-ids are structural bytes, not hashes of keys.
